title: 建築のための数理工Ⅲ(再履修クラス)
subtitle: Integrated Math and Science for Architecture III
courseType:
Mathematics and Science Program
Mathematics and Science Courses
educationalGoal: Students will learn: (1) differentiation (2) partial derivatives (3) integrals
advice: This is a basic course in calculus for students in the Dept. of Architecture. We will cover the following topics: 1. Differentiation and its applications 2. Integration and its applications 3. Integration issues (moment of inertia) Extra classes may be held depending the comprehension level of students. Students are required to review and preview each class. As a matter of particular emphasis, students are required to attempt the exercises after each class. Extra materials may be distributed if necessary. Students are required to show their solution/calculation procedure logically and clearly in each assignment. Students are expected to utilize the Math. and Science Education Research Center or the office hours of the teacher.
books: Textbooks:Integrated Math and Science for Architecture III IV [Kanazawa Institute of Technology] Reference books:None Reserved books:None
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge and skills from Integrated Math and Science for Architecture I, II.

activityGoals.body: Be able to find derivatives of basic functions using the chain rule or the derivative of the inverse function.
Be able to find indefinite or definite integrals using the substitution rule or integration by parts formula.
Be able to explain various problems of architecture using differentiation and integration.
Be able to demonstrate an understanding of all topics, attend all classes, and complete all required work.
Understand the meanings of fundamental English words for mathematics.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Accurately find derivatives of basic functions using the chain rule and the derivative of the inverse function. (2) Accurately find indefinite and definite integrals using the substitution rule and integration by parts. (3) Accurately explain various problems in architecture using differentiation and integration. (4) Demonstrate an understanding of all topics and complete all assignments.
